rules.statement: A co-owner's title and possession are held in disregard of and unaffected by a deed of transfer if the deed is disputed and ignored by other co-owners, and such possession continues for 15 years after the execution of the deed.
rules.supporting_quote: Possession continued in disregard of P8 and had so continued for 15 years after P8 had been executed. Consequently, it was not in reality a case in which the defendants-respondents, had acquired a prescriptive title, but rather a case in which their title and possession were held in disregard of and unaffected by P8.
